doc.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

title: Jackie and Roy recording of Brubeck's music
summary: Rowe plays a 1970s Jackie and Roy track with Paul Desmond and Sebesky arrangements; Brubeck had apparently never heard it.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Okay. This has been most fascinating. To end up I want to just play for you a very short segment, and you know I write a little bit of music myself and I’ve always felt that one of the greatest compliments you can get is when people play your music when you’re not even there.
And so that’s what this is. But I’m sure you’ll recognize it.
That was Jackie & Roy, from about 1972 or 3.
It sounds like there’s more people.
Yeah, they overdubbed that little section in there, the Don Sebesky arrangements, and they hooked up “Summer Song” and “Summertime,” and he plays — it’s absolutely gorgeous. Do you have it?
Must. They would have sent it to me. But it seems like I never heard it. Play it again.
Let’s see if I can get back to—this is the middle section of the piece.
Yeah, and then they go on.
